rule_en: Future perfect (will have + past participle) = finished before a point in the future ('by then'). Future continuous (will be + -ing) = in progress at a point in the future ('at that time').
rule_bn: ভবিষ্যতের কোনো সময়ের আগেই শেষ হবে → future perfect (will have + V3); ভবিষ্যতের কোনো মুহূর্তে চলমান থাকবে → future continuous (will be + V-ing)।

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: By the time the sprint ends on Friday, we ___ all the failing test classes.
items.explain_en: Future perfect (will have + fixed): completed before a future point ('By the time the sprint ends').

items.prompt_en: Don't call me at 3 p.m. tomorrow; I ___ a live demo for the client then.
items.explain_en: Future continuous (will be + running): in progress at that specific future time ('at 3 p.m. ... then').

items.prompt_en: By next December, I ___ at Salesforce for five years.
items.explain_en: Future perfect (will have + worked): a duration completed by a future point ('By next December').

items.prompt_en: This time next week, she ___ on the new Apex integration while we review the design.
items.explain_en: Future continuous (will be + working): ongoing at a future moment ('This time next week').

items.prompt_en: The deploy starts at 9; by 9:30 the pipeline ___ all the unit tests.
items.explain_en: Future perfect (will have + finished): complete before the future point ('by 9:30').

items.prompt_en: By the time you arrive at the office, I ___ the release notes.
items.explain_en: Future perfect (will have written): finished before the future point.

items.prompt_en: At 8 o'clock tonight I ___ for the certification exam, so please don't disturb me.
items.explain_en: Future continuous (will be + studying): in progress at a specific future time ('At 8 o'clock tonight').

items.prompt_en: By the end of this year, our team ___ over fifty bug tickets.
items.explain_en: Future perfect (will have closed): a total completed by a future point.

items.prompt_en: This time tomorrow, we ___ on the train to the conference.
items.explain_en: Future continuous (will be travelling): in progress at that future moment.

items.prompt_en: By the time the manager joins the call, the engineers ___ the root cause.
items.explain_en: Future perfect (will have + found): completed before the future point ('By the time the manager joins').
